title: Bank Deposit Shortfall Delivery Margin by Personal Sender Account Level
content:
The delivery margin taken off the make-good delivery rate on a Bank Deposit shortfall delivery follows the level of the customer's Personal Sender Account, read from the account record at the time of handling.

## Schedule

| Personal Sender Account level | Level number | Delivery margin |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Enhanced, Paloma Premier, Paloma Private Client | 4 or higher | 0 percent (the zero delivery margin) |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 3 | 0.45 percent (the reduced delivery margin) |
| Paloma Starter, Paloma Verified | 1 or 2 | not affected by this schedule |

As a clause: an account at Paloma Enhanced or above (level number 4 or higher) carries the zero delivery margin of 0 percent; an account at Paloma Verified Plus (level number 3) carries the reduced delivery margin of 0.45 percent; an account at any lower level is not affected by this schedule.

## Points of judgement

- **A customer at Paloma Premier.** Level 5 is at or above 4, so the delivery margin is 0 percent.
- **A customer at Paloma Verified Plus whose account is many years old.** The schedule reads the level only, so 0.45 percent.
- **A customer at Paloma Verified.** Level 2: not affected.

The margin is in percentage points of the booking-day reference, the same unit as the tier's exchange-rate margin.
